title: 4th Sitting of 1st Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/4/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for a Non-Resident Ambassador to the Kingdom of Bhutan (Constitution Article 115(d), Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021, Article 14) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination for Permanent Representative to the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Parliament's consent, under Constitution Articles 115(f)(1) and 93(a), for the Maldives to join the Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations for Non-Resident Ambassadors to the State of Kuwait and the Swiss Confederation are sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: Maafannu South MP Abdulla Rifau's proposal to amend the Majlis Rules of Procedure (under Article 272(c) of the Rules) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill on Prevention of Gang Crimes and Other Serious Crimes, submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangoalhi South MP Mustafa Hussain.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to send ambassador nominations, the Berne Convention and a rules-change proposal to committees, then continue debating the government's gang crimes bill.
